reviews.text: Sherlyn helped me; she was very kind and helpful. My experience at Pet Lovers was excellent. All the tests were much cheaper than at other clinics I've been to before. I will recommend them.
Best animal clinic in all of Miami. Been going to pet lovers for over 20 years and leave satisfied every time. Thank you for taking such good care of all my fur kids
Always have the best experience at Pet Lovers. Thank you to all the wonderful staff that’s always so willing to help. So grateful for all the doctors at Pet Lovers they truly all are amazing.
Great service my dog was taken care of and I was treated like family

If you love your dog do not take them here. They have no empathy- my friend had to out gis dog down and they were charging him extra for him to be present during the euthanasia- for no reason at all. Not an ounce of sympathy towards their pain of losing a family member- they only think about the money!
Great to have them!

I brought a rescue cat to Pet Lovers specifically for a dental cleaning and necessary extractions. Before leaving him, I clearly explained that another veterinarian had examined his mouth and found that both back teeth were badly infected and extremely painful. The cat would jump in pain when those areas were barely touched, and he was having so much difficulty that he could no longer eat properly. I was assured that any infected or unhealthy teeth would be removed.

When I returned, I was shocked to learn that no teeth had been extracted because they “weren’t loose enough.” The veterinarian acknowledged that the teeth were infected but said removing them would require stitches, which she could not do and which would need to be handled by a dental specialist.

If this clinic could not perform the extractions my cat needed, they should have told me before proceeding. I would have taken him somewhere else. Instead, I was charged approximately $500 for a cleaning, while the painful, infected teeth I specifically brought him in to have removed were left in place.

I run a cat rescue, and that money came from donations. Now I have $500 less available to pay another veterinarian to perform the procedure this cat urgently needed in the first place. More importantly, he is still in pain and still needs another dental procedure under anesthesia.

This was not a misunderstanding about why he was there. I clearly explained his condition and the need for extractions beforehand. I feel completely let down by the lack of transparency and communication. If a clinic only extracts teeth that are already loose or cannot perform extractions requiring sutures, clients need to be told that before their animal undergoes anesthesia and they are charged for the procedure.
They take care of my dogs there, they are very considerate and provide excellent service.

Dr Reinaldo was excellent I like they explain to you what they recommend and the invoice fully explain all treatment s and you decide what's best very clean and when you pay its what you pay no surprises or new bills I like all the receptionist are friendly and courteous

I had been bringing my dog to this veterinary clinic since she was a puppy, so I was extremely disappointed by my most recent experience.

I brought her in for a few very small growths—one in her mouth and two on her skin—and asked for an estimate to have them removed, biopsied, and to have a dental cleaning done at the same time. Their estimate came out to over $3,200, with several additional charges that, in my opinion, seemed excessive or unnecessary.

Because the price seemed unreasonable, I decided to get a second opinion from another veterinarian I had never visited before. For essentially the same procedures—removal of the growths, dental cleaning, biopsies, etc.—I paid around $800.

I completely understand that veterinary clinics can have different pricing, and I am willing to pay for good care. But a difference of more than $2,000 for comparable services is very difficult to justify.

What disappoints me most is that after being a client here for years and trusting them with my dog since she was little, I did not feel that loyalty was valued at all. Instead, I left feeling like the focus was on adding charges rather than providing reasonable, transparent pricing.

I would strongly recommend getting a second opinion and comparing estimates before agreeing to any expensive procedure here. In my experience, their pricing has become excessively high and unfortunately I can no longer recommend them.

I would have given them 5 stars since they treated my cat and gave him a thorough ear cleaning but he unfortunately contracted a UTI in their care.

I paid around $500 and was relieved to see my cat’s ear better but then a few days later he now has been non stop sneezing and with a runny nose.
Front desk said I need to come in so the doctor can inspect him—sir, this was an issue caused by you under your care. I shouldn’t have to waste my time and pay again to get an issue fixed that was preventable.

It feels like that they are constantly upselling.
Dr Lázaro is very attentive and has knowledge. He explains in detail everything. Our cats are in good hands. Clinic is very clean.
Excellent service, I highly recommend them. Hayris was very kind 🙏 …

I never want to hear about these crooks again in my life. The doctor was very kind, and I'm very grateful; I think his name is Lazaro. But the policies of that clinic are outrageous! My cat has anemia, and the Hill's cans they sell are over $3 each. I could get it from Chewy for half the price, but they wouldn't authorize the purchase from Chewy, claiming that as long as they have it, I have to buy from Pet Lover. Otherwise, I would have to pay a $20 fee for them to authorize the purchase elsewhere. I'm not going to stand idly by, and I'm going to call the city's customer service line because this is the most outrageous thing I've ever seen! 😡😡😡😡😡😡😡

Not good Custumer service . I called about 5 times to get an appointment for my dog and they pick up the phone and put you in hold right away for hours . End up going to this place physically and couldn’t get the service because I didn’t have appointment

My first time at that clinic with my dog, who weighs 1 to 20 pounds, I wanted to get her spayed. First of all, it was super expensive, $853. The bill said to do an x-ray for $198—what kind of logic is that?—and a urine test for $75? "It's not necessary," say the REAL VETERINARIANS. I called 19 clinics for an estimate and none of them asked for those two things. The moral of the story is: they try to squeeze more money out of you, and I'm sure they don't do any of it properly. Even after removing those two things, it was still around $580, which was still expensive for me. Another complaint: the vet who took my dog ​​to weigh her only asked her name and took her away like she was a toy. He didn't greet me, he didn't talk to her. The idea is to introduce her to him so she doesn't get scared, but he took her away like she was an object. She left terrified. The clinic should be called Petmoney instead of Petlover; it would suit them better because they work for money, not out of love for animals. And those who have been to these clinics know they just take advantage of your money. If you want a perfect price, for only $430 it includes blood work, tubal ligation, and all the necessary injections. The only thing not included are the pain pills, which cost less than $20. You can get the same service with better care at FUREVER FRIENDS ANIMAL HOSPITAL. READ CAREFULLY: $430 TO $853 IS HALF PRICE! YOU SAVE
Dr Reinaldo is the best
I cannot put in to words how amazing Brianna was to me and my pet. I am beyond grateful
Reinaldo has taken excellent care to my dog
Excellent service for your pet

To the management of Pets Lovers Clinic: I would like to express the immense gratitude, admiration, and respect that my family and I feel and wish to convey to all the employees, and especially to Dr. Natacha Lau, who practices professionally at Pets Lovers.
Dr. Lau began treating my dog ​​as soon as she arrived from Cuba, with love, concern, and great mastery of her profession. Without regard for economic status or motivation, she emphasized the appropriate treatments.
My pet had three relapses, the last one occurring on June 4th of this year. Her care, gentleness, and maternal advice are and will remain unforgettable for us. Our pet passed away on June 6th at the decision of her owner, who is writing to you. The behavior of the staff and the doctor herself is indescribable. Therefore, since we cannot express our gratitude and love for Dr. Lau in writing, we send her a big hug from afar and proclaim to the world the value of her and Pet Lovers Clinic in Miami.

With much love, Lucy (Bombon's owner).

A pretty good veterinary clinic in terms of reasonable prices and the ability to get care without having to make an appointment.
However, not too long ago they installed a bunch of plug-in air fresheners and it really is excessive; In one room alone there are probably about 5 air fresheners plugged into every single electrical outlet.
For superficial reasons, it bothers me to have to constantly breathe in fragranced air while I wait, and to leave the clinic perfumed by the air freshener. However for serious reasons, I believe that air-fresheners are not good for our health and what of our pets who have senses that are more sensitive than ours? According to the internet, air fresheners release volatile organic compounds into the air, and these compounds can cause "eye, nose, and throat irritation, headaches, nausea, dizziness, and difficulty breathing". "Long-term exposure can damage the liver, kidneys, and central nervous system, and some VOCs are linked to cancer. They may worsen symptoms for people with asthma and COPD".

Hence, as much as I love the service of this clinic, I am hesitant to return until this issue is addressed.

I would rate it three stars but I'm only rating it two so that the clinic will have a reason to read this review.
Nice and clean place, staff was friendly. I was able to make a same day walk in for a stray kitty I found. Reasonable price, and very knowledgeable Vet.
Excellent veterinary clinic. I've been going to them for 7 years and I have absolutely no complaints. On the contrary, they are wonderful.

Wonderful clinic and excellent staff. They treat pets with great respect and dedication. I am so grateful to them for helping my dog.
Thank you!

Excellent team at that clinic, 1000% recommended!
Thank you for your work and dedication to our furry children.

This clinic is awful. I went because someone recommended it as a good clinic, but that's a lie. The service from the staff is terrible, absolutely terrible. It took two hours to get my dog ​​vaccinated, and then after two hours, they told me I had to wait even longer. That's a total lack of respect. To top it all off, the air conditioning was off, and it was incredibly hot. My dog, a Poppy, was vomiting and everything. 🚨 I absolutely do not recommend this clinic to anyone. It's all just a facade; it's a complete and utter garbage.
The place is very clean and welcoming, the service is very good, my dogs are well taken care of.

I want to thank Pet Lovers Animal Clinic for the wonderful experience I had with my puppy. From the moment we arrived, they treated us with so much love, patience, and professionalism.

My puppy went for his vaccinations and literally didn't even realize how gentle and careful they were. That gave me so much peace of mind as an owner. In addition, the clinic is impeccably clean; everything looked super organized, clean, and well-maintained, which is very important to me.

The staff was incredibly friendly and attentive at all times, and they truly made me feel like I was in good hands. I definitely recommend this clinic to anyone who wants their pet to be treated with love and care. An excellent experience from beginning to end! 🐶

I’ve had such a wonderful experience with this clinic and their entire team. Every veterinarian and staff member has been kind, attentive, and incredibly professional. They take the time to answer questions, explain everything thoroughly, and truly care about the well-being of your pets. You never feel rushed and I feel like for me it’s rare to find a clinic where everyone makes you feel so supported and cared for. Highly recommend this team to anyone looking for exceptional veterinary care.

I cannot say enough good things about Dr. Brianna Perez. She is incredibly compassionate, knowledgeable, and genuinely cares about both her patients and their owners. Every interaction feels personal, never rushed, and her attention to detail is amazing. She goes above and beyond with communication and follow-up, which is so rare to find. Truly one of the best veterinary experiences I’ve ever had.

Dr. Brianna Perez is truly outstanding. From the moment we met her, she treated us with so much kindness, compassion, and care. She is incredibly knowledgeable, detail-oriented, and thoughtful in the way she approaches everything. Her follow-up and attention to her patients are unmatched, and she genuinely makes you feel like family. I’m so grateful to have found a vet I trust this much.
Staff is very kind and efficient. Doctors are knowledgable and kind. I highly recommend.
The best of the best
🫶🥰🥰 Always the best …
Magnificent place, very well set up, excellent medical attention and expertise, I highly recommend it, easy parking, we were very pleased, I recommend it
Excellent care and treatment of our pets.
The caring and Dr. Are great love it!!!!

I can understand that they're busy at reception, but waiting on multiple calls for more than 20 minutes seems a bit excessive.

And they never answered me.

Wonderful vets! They also provide warm, kind and thoughtful service. The prices are reasonable and you always feel like you are being treated with transparency and respect. I moved further away from the clinic but I still travel the extra 20 mins for pet lovers. Love them so much!

I decided to leave this review for Pet Lover Clinic at their 7th Street location.

Today, my cat had a spay appointment at 12:00 p.m.; however, I arrived around 10:00 a.m. I waited approximately an hour before being seen. The veterinarian, as always, was very kind and explained everything clearly, so I left my cat for the procedure.

The veterinarian had told me there were two surgeries scheduled before my pet's and that they might start her around 2:30–3:00 p.m. However, that didn't happen. At 6:00 p.m., I was informed that she still hadn't been operated on and that I should pick her up between 6:15 and 6:30 p.m., before the clinic closed.

In other words, my cat was the last patient of the day, more than five hours after her original appointment.

This not only caused concern due to the prolonged period of pre-operative stress for our pet, but it also significantly impacted our personal plans, as we had to postpone important commitments while we waited.

Furthermore, it's worth noting that prices have increased considerably compared to previous visits. We understand this may be due to external factors; however, it's disappointing that the day we paid the most was also the day we received the worst service.

We hope that these situations can be improved in the future, especially regarding scheduling and customer communication.
Excellent service, I always take my dog ​​there.
We felt very comfortable; the team is patient and answers all our questions. They explain all the procedures step by step and are transparent about the prices. I'm very satisfied.

I've visited the clinic twice with my dog ​​Manolo, and the service is excellent and the prices are very fair. At other places, they often try to charge high amounts by ordering unnecessary tests and procedures. Miami Pet Lovers is the best veterinary clinic I've ever been to.

I've visited the clinic twice with my dog ​​Manolo, and the service has been excellent with very fair pricing. At other places, they often try to charge high amounts by ordering unnecessary tests and procedures. Miami Pet Lovers is the best veterinary clinic I've been to.

The worst experience of my life at this clinic. I went on Thursday with my dog ​​who had diarrhea. My dog ​​is almost 3 years old, vaccinated, and in good spirits. She only had bloody diarrhea, and the doctor said he thought it was a stomach bug. They ordered all sorts of tests to charge me a $1000 bill, which I accepted because I just wanted her to be okay. They told me my dog ​​had palvovirus, which was unbelievable even to the doctor. They prescribed a lot of pills, including metronidazole and amoxicillin—super strong ones. In the early hours of Saturday morning, after she'd been on the treatment for two days, I had to rush her to the emergency room because she was vomiting. I went to two different clinics, and they told me it was very unlikely she had the virus because of her state of mind. I asked them to repeat the tests, and they came back negative. A virus doesn't cure in two days, and what my dog ​​had was just an upset stomach. They prescribed antibiotics, which made things worse and caused her to vomit because she didn't actually have the virus, and they prescribed strong antibiotics. I called to complain and they told me they were going to change the tests because apparently the tests were faulty, and this had already happened with two other dogs. I think it's a total lack of respect because if it had already happened to them, why didn't they throw away the tests or why didn't they verify their diagnosis? That's negligence, and that's how they can kill an animal. My dog ​​only had an upset stomach, and because of their malpractice, she almost became dehydrated from vomiting because they prescribed strong antibiotics when she only had an upset stomach. I have proof of their results and from the other clinic. I don't recommend going to this clinic at all. When I called to complain, they just apologized. An apology doesn't undo the damage; an apology doesn't cure my dog. And I repeat, before mine, they had already had two dogs with a false positive for parvovirus, and they still continued using those tests. If they're negligent with this, who knows what else they're negligent with? They just want to collect payment and don't care about the pet's well-being. Two other clinics I went to realized that the positive result for turkey virus wasn't right.

Unethical clinic. Their prices look cheap at first, but they prescribe a lot of unnecessary treatments. It feels like they are trying to sell you as much as possible.
They rush you out of the exam room to move to the next patient, but then you end up waiting for hours in different lines, including just to get a quote for everything they decided your pet “needs.”
If you love your pet, don’t take them here. Find an ethical vet instead.

This animal clinic is absolutely amazing. I 100% recommend it to anyone looking for an animal clinic. I truly felt the love and care they provided for my dog. Dr. Lazaro, his assistant Ernesto, and honestly the entire staff were honorable and kind-hearted people. The clinic is very clean, safe, and welcoming. I would trust them with any animal.
Extremely expensive but the place is amazing. The staff is loving and have a passion for caring for our fur babies. I’ve been with them since 2011.
Excellent in all services. Excellent staff, 100 out of 100.

I LOVE THIS PLACE! I was recommended by a friend, my pet baby had an extraction done and his cleaning, they were fast, efficient and super friendly. The location is super clean and organized and the staff was friendly and informative; I will be coming for all my pet needs FOR SURE! And the best part, it wasn't a crazy bill! 1000% RECOMMEND THEM, ESPECIALLY THIS LOCATION!

I brought my kitten here twice.

During the first visit, we did his annual vaccines and I was told his ears were inflamed due to yeast. They ran tests and prescribed antibiotic drops.

At the second visit, the experience was extremely concerning. The doctor did not speak English and made no effort to communicate. He did not review my kitten’s chart and prepared duplicate vaccines that had already been given at the previous appointment. Thankfully, an English-speaking nurse stepped in and clarified.

The doctor was rude, did not explain what he was doing, and handled my kitten without asking or walking me through the process. He recommended an ear flush under anesthesia and prescribed strong antibiotics. The estimate for the proposed procedures and medications was around $450.

I felt uneasy and went for a second opinion the same day at another clinic. My kitten was diagnosed with ear mites, yeast was a consequence. I was given a topical gel, clear instructions on how to treat and clean his ears, and all my questions were answered. The total cost was under $100.

This means the original diagnosis was incorrect, and the second visit would have led to unnecessary anesthesia and heavy antibiotics.

Beyond the cost difference, the lack of communication, failure to review records, and overall treatment were unacceptable. Our pets are family. Transparency, competence, and basic respect should be standard.

I will not be returning.

If you choose to use this clinic, I strongly recommend getting a second opinion before agreeing to major procedures or expensive treatments.

Today I want to share a wonderful experience. Today, February 12, 2026, I took my dog, Paloma, to the clinic. Dr. Natacha Lau treated her. I have to say, I'm very demanding when it comes to service, and I'm so impressed with the treatment, the attention, and the cleanliness of the place—it's excellent! 👌 From the moment you walk in, the staff greets you warmly. Then, the very kind technician directs you to see Dr. Lau. She's incredible, so sweet. She explains everything and gives you the opportunity to ask questions. She doesn't send you unnecessary things just to charge you. And what can I say about when you're leaving and the staff in the back explain everything in such detail, without rushing. They give you a copy of everything they did for your pet. I'm so excited because these days it's hard to find a place where you get the complete package. THANK YOU SO MUCH FOR EVERYTHING!

Our experience was very disappointing, my dog was not feeling well,vomiting and with diarrhea, was diagnosed with Parvovirus, I have another dog at the house, a puppy and imagine how we feel about loosing ours dogs, after been with two days under IV treatment, decided to take our dog for a sexo d opinion to ER, and guess what ?
NEGATIVE FOR PARVOVIRUS
We all feel relieve but very upset.
I’m just sharing my experience.

All staff has been great with Teenybell. D Lazaro  takes care of My 18 years old baby and he’s very careful with her. Dr. Lazaro is great,  always go tru her exams and explains all the details. I’m grateful that my baby receives such a good care.  The staff takes great care of her when she needs to stay for her treatments. Thank you!

I've been a client of the clinic for two years and they've always provided excellent service. My dog ​​has had two surgeries, and I have absolutely no complaints about them. I'm truly grateful to have found them and I highly recommend them.

I went there because I was told by Animal Services that this place was inexpensive. As I'm a 100% disabled Vet, and I live on a budget, Iwas looking to find a reasonable place that doesn't empty your wallet as most animal clinics do; however, at this place, they took full advantage of my ignorance and concerns. I ended up paying $1000 dollars of different tests and medicines that actually only got my dog in a worse condition afterwards. These people would ask me to choose what treatment to get for the dog as if I was barganing for the dog's health without telling me what they thought could be wrong as professional animal doctors... They ask me to choose a treatment between different prices as if I knew what was wrong with my dog; when, I went there to find out what was wrong with my dog in the first place, to see what could be with the dog. I was there to be helped and guided by someone who knew about dogs, and to save money; instead, I was taken full advantage of. I went there to be helped, and I ended up paying way more than I bargained for; I paid as if I had gone to any other expensive clinic or worse... In the end, after 3 days, the dog got worse with this clinic's medicine, so I stopped. I had to take my dog to another vet to finally get results. The problem with my dog was mainly due to the rapid growth side effect. I feel Pet Lovers is a scam...
